synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “for”.
synth.s1: My neighbours gave us pineapple tarts.
synth.s2: They gave them to us for Chinese New Year.
synth.lead: My neighbours gave us pineapple tarts
synth.explain: Use 'for' to say which occasion it was for.
synth.say: My neighbours gave us pineapple tarts. They gave them to us for Chinese New Year.
synth.full: My neighbours gave us pineapple tarts for Chinese New Year.

synth.lead: The kopitiam opens at six in the morning
answers: and is already busy by seven
synth.answer: and is already busy by seven
synth.say: The kopitiam opens at six in the morning. The kopitiam is already busy by seven.

passages.title: A Hari Raya Lunch at Work
passages.text: For Hari Raya, my colleagues and I organised a small gathering at the office. We ⟦1|order⟧ food from a nearby Malay restaurant and ⟦2|invitd⟧ everyone to join us. It was a pleasant way to celebrate together.
passages.say: For Hari Raya, my colleagues and I organised a small gathering at the office. We ordered food from a nearby Malay restaurant and invited everyone to join us. It was a pleasant way to celebrate together.
